title: Full Day Private Halifax Coastal Tour Peggy’s Cove & Lunenburg
blurb:
Explore the very best of Halifax and Nova Scotia’s stunning South Shore on this private full-day experience. 

Begin with a visit to the iconic Halifax Citadel National Historic Site, where panoramic city views and rich military history bring Halifax’s past to life. 

Continue to the moving Fairview Lawn Cemetery, home to the graves of Titanic victims and one of the city’s most historic landmarks. 

From there, journey along the scenic coast to the world-famous Peggy's Cove Lighthouse for breathtaking ocean views and unforgettable photos. 

Stroll the charming waterfront of Mahone Bay before heading to the UNESCO World Heritage town of Lunenburg, known for its colorful buildings, maritime heritage, and picturesque harbor. 

Enjoy the comfort and flexibility of a private tour with hotel or cruise pickup and drop-off included, making this the perfect way to experience Nova Scotia’s most iconic highlights in one unforgettable day.
